searchText: I notice `is_valid_indexed_payload_attestation` calls `get_domain` with `epoch = None` [here](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/92dda6fbb137a44fb443630c65b0f421c921d0cb/specs/gloas/beacon-chain.md?plain=1#L394) which means `get_domain` will get the fork version of the epoch of state.slot, but in the spec test, looks like `prepare_signed_payload_attestation` is using the attesting slot (there it is using state.slot - 1 for attesting slot) for the domain [here](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/92dda6fbb137a44fb443630c65b0f421c921d0cb/tests/core/pyspec/eth2spec/test/gloas/block_processing/test_process_payload_attestation.py#L87). Which one is correct? <@1035747431461167125> did you get the spec test to pass? No, I am getting invalid signature for `IndexedPayloadAttestation`, but I doubt the redundant field `blob_data_available` would cause spec test to generate invalid signature. I am reviewing my ptc index calculation and see if that's where the problem is Which test is this exactly? ``` FAIL spec-minimal test/spec/presets/operations.test.ts > gloas/operations/payload_attestation/pyspec_tests > gloas/operations/payload_attestation/pyspec_tests/process_payload_attestation_partial_participation FAIL spec-minimal test/spec/presets/operations.test.ts > gloas/operations/payload_attestation/pyspec_tests > gloas/operations/payload_attestation/pyspec_tests/process_payload_attestation_payload_not_present FAIL spec-minimal test/spec/presets/operations.test.ts > gloas/operations/payload_attestation/pyspec_tests > gloas/operations/payload_attestation/pyspec_tests/process_payload_attestation_payload_present ``` I’m still on beta.0 spec if this makes any difference has anyone come up with a name for a `Block` or `Envelope`? Like a segment of the chain is no longer a string of blocks.. it's an interlaced string of blocks and envelopes.. so what do you call a single link in that chain that can be either a block or an envelope? we're kind of no longer a "block" chain we're a.. Blope? chain? PayLock chain? idk
